name: Stratagem Compendium
description: Eleven new stratagems: four Pelican support runs (Gatling, Cannon, EMS, Gas), the A/MG-101 Heavy MG Sentry, Orbital Gas and EMS Barrages, three expendable launchers (Cluster, Gas, EMS) and the MS-N223 Shredder Silo, under a heading of their own in the selection screen.
